title: Pilot field boundaries (detected from Landsat)
fetched: 93 field-like irrigated shapes detected in the pilot box; 14 chosen as pilot fields ({"long-stand alfalfa": 8, "alfalfa with breaks": 4, "mostly other crops": 2})
resolution: 30 m (Landsat); each field is the largest circle inside its irrigated footprint
credit: Derived by this project from Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 (USGS/NASA) and the USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer.
message: 14 pilot fields, 37-58 ha, median radius 403 m
notes: OpenET's /geodatabase/metadata/ids endpoint returned HTTP 400 'Invalid geometry' for every request, including the example in its own documentation, so OpenET's field boundaries could not be used. Boundaries here are satellite-derived approximations.
